subject: Starlight Health: Portal onboarding — MSA redlines & PO field tie-out
messages:
From: Sara Dunn <sara.dunn@starlighthealth.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood onboarding — MSA redlines & portal fields

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — we want to move forward but need to align two parallel tracks before we can finish procurement:

1) Our legal team reviewed the MSA and attached an initial redline (see attached). There are three items they flagged as blockers: data retention/segregation language, indemnity cap carve-outs for BAA-covered data, and audit access timing.

2) Our procurement/ops team is running the Ariba registration and is hitting field mismatches between your Order Form export and our PO schema. Specifically: PO number formatting, ship-to vs bill-to mapping, and EDI acknowledgment window. We attached a spreadsheet with the fields we need to confirm.

Can you put us in contact with the person on your side who will own the portal field tie-outs (Ariba/Coupa mapping) and confirm who on legal will take the MSA redline? We need both threads closed by 9/30 to make our Q4 vendor list.

Best,
Sara Dunn
Procurement Manager
Starlight Health
[Attachment: Starlight_MSA_comments.pdf (pdf)]

From: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — MSA redlines & portal fields

Sara — thanks for the clear notes and the spreadsheet. Taking ownership on the portal side from the Redwood ops angle; Kimberly (Legal Ops) and Mateo (Legal) are looping in for the MSA items.

Action plan from our side:
- Kimberly will review and provide line-by-line responses to your redlines by 9/20.
- Mateo will escalate the indemnity/audit windows with our counsel and propose alternate language where necessary.
- I'll work with Ariba onboarding to map the fields you called out and confirm the PO format/EDI ack window. If we need a short schema transform on our export we can add that as a one-off mapping.

Can you confirm whether your EDI team requires PO Number padded to 12 digits or if a variable-length numeric PO is acceptable? Also, please attach a sample PO your system sent previously if you have one.

I'll attach the orderform field matrix we're using so we can do a side-by-side.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Redwood onboarding — MSA redlines & portal fields

Forwarding our redline draft and a short note. I added inline comments where we think a compliance-friendly compromise will work (see highlighted rows). Two points for clarity:

- Data retention: we can accept a customer-driven retention period for non-PII logs if Starlight agrees to a 90-day minimum for telemetry needed for fraud and abuse detection.
- Audit timing: propose an SLA for audit response (10 business days for evidence access) rather than on-demand onsite audits; we can accommodate SOC2 report delivery and remote log extracts.

Quoted for context:
> On Fri, 18 Sep 2027 at 09:12 Sara Dunn <sara.dunn@starlighthealth.com> wrote:
> > Thanks for the demo yesterday — we want to move forward but need to align two parallel tracks before we can finish procurement:
> > 1) Our legal team reviewed the MSA and attached an initial redline (see attached).
> > 2) Our procurement/ops team is running the Ariba registration and is hitting field mismatches...

Attachments I'm sending here: MSA_Starlight_redlines_v1.docx (docx) with inline comments; a proposed replacement paragraph for indemnity (docx); and the orderform field matrix exported as an XLSX.

Kimberly Park

Sara — quick update after internal sync:

- Legal: Kimberly and Mateo have a tracked-change MSA back to you (attached). Key compromise language for indemnity and audit is inline; please let us know if your counsel wants to call a 30-minute touch to resolve wording.
- Portal/ops: Ariba onboarding confirmed the mapping approach — we will add a transform to pad PO numbers to 12 characters on export and map your Ship-To/Bill-To to the XML <ShipToParty> element. The EDI ack window will be set at 24 hours per your team's request.

Next steps:
1) Sara: confirm your counsel is OK with the proposed audit SLA or suggest one alternate timebox.
2) Procurement: please send a sample PO (or a sanitized example) so we can validate the padding and mapping in staging.
3) Jonas: I'll schedule a 30-minute triage call for Thursday 9/23 to validate the staging test and sign off on the redline.

Thanks all — making good progress.

Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
